name: Pangang Group Vanadium & Titanium Resources Co., Ltd.
summary: Pangang Group Vanadium & Titanium Resources Co., Ltd. engages in the technology research and development, production, sales, and application development of sail products, titanium dioxide and titanium slag in China and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Titanium, Machinery, Electricity, and Others. It provides sail oxide, sail iron, sail nitrogen alloy, sail aluminum alloy, sail electrolyte, titanium dioxide, titanium slag, and others. The company also engages in the electricity business.
